data.title: E3: honest 'For organisations' fake door on kadence.guru/pricing
data.description: Three lines (core free MIT forever; under consideration: one view across repositories, $10 per active person, agents free, 3 repos and 10 people free; not built yet, tell us what you would ask it), a mailto/booking button, no new tracking. Site work, so owner's yes under the tech pause. Pass: >= 5 requests from distinct companies with >= 3 repos in 60 days, >= 2 calls.
